recent.text: Vic’s hot. Tomáš Hertl with a shot from the top of the right circle, then Saros makes another save on Barbashev, and Olofsson finally gets it to go while falling down. It’s his third goal in his last three periods of hockey. 1-1 https://t.co/ut262lZVND

recent.text: The save from Saros is exceptional. The set up from Hertl to Barbashev was excellent. That line is carrying #VGK early on.
